raw.result:
Exploring the workspace and scaffolding a polished, flagship-quality training planner and physiological simulator.


Building a polished React + TypeScript app with physiological models, plan generation, PMC visualization, and export capabilities.


Implementing core physiology libraries and the application UI.


**VeloLab — Adaptive Endurance Studio** is in `/workspace/endurance-planner`. It’s a React + TypeScript app with the physiology, planning, PMC, exports, and adaptation behavior you described.

### Run it

```bash
cd /workspace/endurance-planner
npm install
npm run dev
```

Open the URL Vite prints (usually `http://localhost:5173`).

### What you get

| Area | Behavior |
|------|----------|
| **Athlete** | FTP, W/kg, optional VO₂max or race-derived **VDOT**, LTHR, 200/400 swim test → **CSS**, weekly hours & sessions, starting **CTL** |
| **Zones** | **Coggan** 7-zone power, **Daniels** E/M/T/I/R paces, LTHR HR bands, CSS swim paces |
| **Plan** | **Base → Build → Peak → Taper** plus recovery weeks; **triathlon**, **running**, **cycling**, or **cross-training** (bike, run, strength) |
| **Workouts** | Interval block profiles (warm-up, work, recovery, cool-down / strength); per-session status |
| **PMC** | Daily **TSS**, **CTL** (÷42), **ATL** (÷7), **TSB**; dashed = original plan, solid = adapted |
| **Adaptation** | Skip / shorten / over-reach on sessions; illness simulation; hour & session overrides; **Recalibrate** future weeks (~8% ramp cap) |
| **Export** | Full plan **`.ics`**; bike sessions **`.zwo`** (Zwift) |

### Code layout

- `src/lib/zones.ts` — Coggan, Daniels/VDOT, CSS, HR  
- `src/lib/tss.ts` — cycling TSS, rTSS, sTSS  
- `src/lib/pmc.ts` — Banister EWMA  
- `src/lib/planGenerator.ts` — mesocycles & structured intervals  
- `src/lib/adaptation.ts` — live recalibration  
- `src/lib/exportIcs.ts` / `exportZwo.ts` — downloads  

On first load a sample **12-week triathlon** plan is generated so **Performance** and **Plan & Workouts** are populated immediately. Adjust the profile, pick a discipline and race date, then **Generate periodized plan** or **Regenerate plan** on the Plan tab. Mark session outcomes on workout cards, recalibrate on **Adaptation**, and compare PMC curves on **Performance**.
